S.O. 29(E).— Whereas, the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967 (37 of 1967) (hereinafter referred to 


as the said Act) has been enacted to provide for more effective prevention of certain unlawful activities of individuals 
and associations and for dealing with terrorist activities and for matters connected therewith; 


And whereas, clause (a) of sub-section (1) and sub-section (2) of section 35 of the said Act empowers the 
Central Government to add the name of an individual in the Fourth Schedule to the said Act, if it believes that he is 
involved in terrorism; 


And whereas, Aijaz Ahmad Ahanger @ Abu Usman Al-Kashmiri son of Mohd. Abdullah Ahanger born in 
Nawakadal, Srinagar in 1974 presently based in Afghanistan is one of the chief recruiters of Islamic State Jammu and 
Kashmir (ISJK); 


And whereas, the said Aijaz Ahmad Ahanger has close contacts with Al- Qaida and other Global Terrorist 
Groups and is engaged in restarting the Islamic State (IS) channels in India; 


And whereas, the said Aijaz Ahmad Ahanger is working towards providing traction to militancy in Kashmir 
and has started the process of identifying people for inclusion in his Kashmir based network; 


[भाग व---खण्ड 3(1i)] भारत का राजपत्र : असाधारण 3 


And whereas, the said Aijaz Ahmad Ahanger was appointed as head of Islamic State (IS) recruitment cell for 
India and had been instrumental in initiating an online India-centric ISIS Propaganda Magazine; 


And whereas, the said Aijaz Ahmad Ahanger is a wanted terrorist in Jammu and Kashmir for more than two 
decades and has started planning terror related strategies in Jammu and Kashmir by building coordination channels 
between various terrorist organisations; 


And whereas, the Central Government believes that Aijaz Ahmad Ahanger @ Abu Usman Al-Kashmiri is 
involved in terrorism and the said Aijaz Ahmad Ahanger @ Abu Usman Al-Kashmiri is to be added as a terrorist 
under the said Act; 


Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by clause (a) of sub-section (1) of section 35 of the 
Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967, the Central Government hereby makes the following amendment in the 
Fourth Schedule to the said Act, namely:- 


In the Fourth Schedule to the said Act, after serial number 48 and entries relating thereto, the following serial 
number and entries shall be inserted, namely: - 


“49. Aijaz Ahmad Ahanger @ Abu Usman Al-Kashmini ”.

3. सभी मामलों में , जहां फायदाग्राहियों के खराब बायोमेट्रिक्स के कारण या किसी अन्य कारण से आधार प्रमाणीकरण 
विफल हो जाता है , निम्नलिखित उपचारात्मक तंत्र को अपनाया जाएगा , अर्थात् : 

क . 


फिंगरप्रिंट की खराब गुणवत्ता के मामले में , प्रमाणीकरण के लिए आईरिस स्कैन या फेस ऑथेंटिकेशन सुविधा 
अपनाई जाएगी , और विभाग अपने कार्यान्वयन अभिकरण के माध्यम से आईरिस स्कैनर या फ़िंगर 
ऑथेंटिकेशन के साथ फ़िंगरप्रिंट प्रमाणीकरण से निर्बाध रीति से फायदे का परिदान की व्यवस्था करेगा ; 


ख . फिंगरप्रिंट या आईरिस स्कैन या फेस ऑथेंटिकेशन के माध्यम से बायोमेट्रिक प्रमाणीकरण सफल नहीं होने 
पर , जहां भी संभव और स्वीकार्य हो आधार वन टाइम पासवर्ड या टाइम - बेस्ड वन टाइम पासवर्ड द्वारा 
सीमित समय विधिमान्यता के साथ मान्य प्रमाणीकरण , जैसी भी स्थिति हो , की व्यवस्था की जाएगी ; 


उन सभी अन्य मामलों में जहां बायोमेट्रिक या आधार वन टाइम पासवर्ड या टाइम - आधारित वन टाइम 
पासवर्ड प्रमाणीकरण संभव नहीं है , स्कीमके अधीन फायदा वास्तविक आधार पत्र के आधार पर दिया जा 
सकता है जिसकी प्रामाणिकता आधार पत्र पर मुद्रित त्वरित प्रतिक्रिया ( क्यूआर ) कोड द्वारा सत्यापित की 
जा सकती है और विभाग द्वारा अपने कार्यान्वयन अभिकरण द्वारा सुविधाजनक स्थानों पर क्यूआर कोड 
रीडर की आवश्यक व्यवस्था उपलब्ध कराई जाएगी । 


4 


4. यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कि स्कीम के अधीन कोई भी वास्तविक फायदाग्राही उन्हें देय फायदों से वंचित नहीं है , 
विभाग अपने कार्यान्वयन अभिकरण के माध्यम से प्रत्यक्ष फायदा हस्तांतरण मिशन , मंत्रिमंडलसचिवालय , भारत सरकार 
के कार्यालय ज्ञापन सं . डी -26011 / 04 / 2017 - डीबीटी , दिनांक 19 दिसंबर 2017 में निर्दिष्ट अपवाद प्रबंधन तंत्र का पालन 
करेगा । 


5. यह अधिसूचना सभी राज्यों और संघ शासित क्षेत्रमें इसके प्रकाशन की तारीख से प्रभावी होगी ।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 


NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 4th January , 2023 

S.O. 19 ( E ) .– Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways , S.O. 5484 Dated 24.11.2022 , published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section Sub 
section ( ii ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building ( widening / four - laning , etc. ) , maintenance , management and operation 
of Ring Road on the stretch of land from Km . 19.100 to Km . 39.200 ( SDM ( Revenue ) Office Jabalpur ) in the district 
of JABALPUR in the state of MADHYA PRADESH ; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “ Dainik Bhaskar Jabalpur " and 
“ The Hitavada Jabalpur " both dated 02.12.2022 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

New Delhi , the 4th January , 2023 

S.O. 20 ( E ) .– Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways , S.O.4966 ( E ) dated 20th October 2022 , published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 3 , 
Sub - Section ( ii ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highways Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) 
( hereinafter referred to as the said act ) , the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building ( widening / four laning , etc. ) , maintenance , management and 
operation of National Highway No. 206 in the stretch of land from Km . 06.000 to Km . 45.500 ( Tumakuru 
Shivamogga section ) in the district of Tumakuru in the State of Karnataka . 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " UDAYAVANI ( Kannada ) and 
" DECCAN HERALD " ( English ) both dated 16th November 2022 under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent authority ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in the exercise of the powers 
conferred by sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

वित्त पर नीतिगत मामलों में अन्य बातों के अलावा , बजट की समीक्षा , अंतिम खाते , लेखा परीक्षा फीस , धन का 
निवेश , कोष में स्थानांतरण , मूल्यह्रास , ब्याज , धन का आवंटन , छात्र ऋण से संबंधित मामले शामिल हो सकते है । 
छात्रवृत्ति , खरीद प्रक्रिया , लागतः राजस्त्र , संपत्ति का बट्टे खाते में डालना , समूह बीमा योजना की समीक्षा , संस्थान 
की संसाधन जुटाने की रणनीति , वित्तीय शक्तियों का प्रत्यायोजन , आदि ; 

संस्थान को समग्र विकास रणनीति के भाग के रूप में वित्त लेखा परीक्षा समिति और लेखा परीक्षा समिति की 
सिफारिश पर बोर्ड के निर्णयों द्वारा निधियों के आवेदन को निधि और मात्रा ( कॉपर्स , निर्धारित और नामनिर्दिष्ट 
निधि सहित ) का नियंत्रित किया जाएगा ;

की जाती है ; 

यह किसी विशेष वित्तीय वर्ष के लिए धन के आवेदन के तरीके और मात्रा को ध्यान में रखता है ; 

बोर्ड वित्तीय वर्ष के लिए वार्षिक खातों को अपनाने के समय , वित्त समिति की एक सिफारिश के आधार पर , उस

रखते हुए विशिष्ट निधियों में स्थानांतरण और संस्थान की दीर्घकालिक दृष्टि भी अनुमोदित करता है ; 

शासी बोर्ड संस्थान की बुनियादी ढांचा परियोजनाओं के लिए एजेंसियों या भारत सरकार द्वारा अनुमोदित विशेष

परंतु अनुसंधान या परामर्श के लिए समर्पित समय जिसके लिए भुगतान किया जा रहा है , प्रति वर्ष बावन दिनों की 
समय सीमा और मानदेय या आय की गणना अनुसंधान / परामर्श बजट में विशेष रूप से प्रदान किया गया है ; 
अनुसंधान और शैक्षणिक क्रियाकलापों को आगे बढ़ाने के लिए संस्थान की पत्रिकाओं आवधिक रूप से और अन्य 
प्रकाशनों का प्रकाशन करना ;

भागीदारी और वित्तीय बजट को मंजूरी देना ; 

एक कार्यक्रम को रद्द करने और कार्यक्रम के विरुद्ध बुक किए गए खर्च को बट्टे खाते में डालने का अनुमोदन ; 

मामला दर मामला आधार पर प्रतिभागियों की गैर - भागीदारी के लिए शुल्क वापस करना ; 


प्रबंधन विकास केंद्रों और कक्षाओं में रहने और रहने के लिए शुल्क की अनुसूची को मंजूरी देना और स्त्रीकृत बजट 
अनुमानों के भीतर हाउसकीपिंग या खरीद के लिए खर्च को मंजूरी देना ;

सभी नीतियों , प्रक्रियाओं और मानदेय का प्रस्ताव करेगा ।

करना ; 


उपयुक्त 

जांच करने के पश्चात प्रत्येक मामले में अनुमोदित सीमा के भीतर नकद नुकसान को बट्टे खाते में डालना , 
यदि किसी अधिकारी को शासी बोर्ड के पूर्व अनुमोदन से उत्तरदायी नहीं ठहराया जा सकता है ; 

साधारण वित्तीय नियम 2017 यथावश्यक परिवर्तनों सहित लागू होंगे । 


सामान्य अनुकम मे , निदेशक यह सुनिश्चित करेगा कि सभी खर्च बोर्ड द्वारा अनुमोदित बजट के विरुद्ध है और 
भुगतान अधिकाधिक प्रक्रियाओं और मानदंडों के अनुसार सख्ती से किए गए हैं ; 

असाधारण या अपरिहार्य परिस्थितियों में जहां कोई क्रियाकलाप आरंभ किया जाना है और भुगतान ( पूजी या 
राजस्व ) तत्काल आधार पर किया जाना है , निदेशक के पास निर्धारित खरीद प्रक्रियाओं पर विचार करने और 
अनुमोदन करने का विवेक होगा । असाधारण या अपरिहार्य परिस्थितियों के लिए । यदि निदेशक स्थिति का 
मूल्यांकन करने के पश्चात संतुष्ट हो जाता है कि संस्थान के बेहतर हित में तत्काल या असाधारण स्थिति को देखते 
हुए निर्धारित प्रक्रिया का पालन नहीं किया जा सकता है , तो वह अनुसमर्थन के लिए बोर्ड को बाद की बैठक में इसे 
मंजूरी दे सकता है और रख सकता है । निदेशक स्वयं को संतुष्ट करने के बाद ही इन शक्तियों का प्रयोग करेगा कि 
स्थिति की तात्कालिकता को देखते हुए , पूरी खरीद प्रक्रिया और निर्धारित प्रक्रिया का पालन करना मुश्किल होगा ।

The Board shall meet at least once in every three months ; 

Every meeting of the Board shall be presided over by the Chairperson . One - third of the total 
members of the Board including the Chairperson shall constitute the quorum for any meeting of the 
Board ; 


In case the Chairperson of the Board is unable to exercise his powers for any cause , the Chairperson 
shall appoint a member to act on his behalf . In the absence of such an appointee , the members shall 
elect from amongst the member present to act on the behalf of the Chairperson ; 

On a written request by a more than fifty per cent of the total members , the Chairperson shall call 
for a special meeting ; 


Any amendments , subsequent to the notification of the First Regulations shall require to be passed 
by a super majority of two - thirds of the full Board ; 

All questions considered at the meetings of the Board shall be decided by consensus of the members 
present including the Chairperson . In case of difference of opinion amongst the members , the 
opinion of more than fifty percent of the members present and voting shall prevail ; 

Each member of the Board including the Chairperson shall have one vote by show of hands and if 
there shall be an equality of votes on any question to be determined by the Board , the Chairperson 
shall in addition have and exercise a casting vote ; 


The Secretary shall send a written notice of every meeting to every member of the Board at least 
fifteen days before the date of the meeting ; 


The notice of meetings may be delivered either by hand or sent by registered post or email or fax , at 
the address of each member and , if so sent , shall be deemed to have been duly delivered in the 
ordinary course of post or , in the case of email or fax , when the same is transmitted ; 

The written notice shall state the place and the date and time of the meeting ; 

The Chairperson may call a special meeting of the Board at shorter notice to consider any urgent 
special issues ; 


Meetings of the Board shall be held within the premises of the Institute unless a different venue is 
identified by an advance notice of reasonable cause by the Chairperson ; 

Chairperson may allow members to attend meetings via video conference or telephonically ; 

Agenda and all relevant documents forming part of the agenda shall be circulated by the Secretary to 
the members at least seven days before the meeting unless such meeting is held at short notice in 
compliance with these regulations ; 


Notices of motions for inclusion of any item on the agenda must reach the Secretary at least ten days 
before the meeting , except for such meetings held at shorter notice in compliance with these 
regulations or with the consent of the Chairperson ; 

Any resolution , except such as may need to be placed before the meeting of the Board , may be 
adopted by circulation among all its members . 


Any resolution so circulated shall be as effective and binding as if such resolution had been passed 
at a meeting of the Board : 


Provided that in every such case a more than fifty per cent of the members of the Board shall have 
recorded their approval of the resolution ; 

The minutes of the proceedings of a meeting of the Board shall be drawn up by the Secretary within 
fourteen working days and circulated to all members of the Board ; 

The minutes shall be placed for confirmation by circulation or at the next meeting of the Board ; 

A member of the Board , other than a nominee of the Central Government or the State Government , 
who fails to attend three consecutive meetings of the Board without permission of the Chairperson , 
shall cease to be a member of the Board ; 


Members who are not in a position to attend a meeting of the Board shall seek permission for leave 
of absence in writing , prior to the meeting ; 


Where in the opinion of the Chairperson or the Director the situation is so emergent that an 
immediate decision needs to be taken in the interest of the Institute , the Chairperson , in consultation 
with the Director may issue such orders as may be necessary , recording the grounds for his opinion : 
Provided that such orders shall be submitted for ratification by the Board in the next meeting .

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 4th January , 2023 

S.O. 23 ( E ) – Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways , S.O - 517 ( E ) dated 09.02.2022 published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 3 , Sub 
section ( ii ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building ( Two / four - laning , etc. ) , maintenance , management and operation of 
NH - 244 on the stretch of land from Km 4.862 to Km 12.850 Sudhmahadev Dranga Tunnel and approach raod in the 
district of Doda in the state of JAMMU & KASHMIR . 


[ भाग II— खण्ड 3 ( ii ) ]

And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " State Times ( English ) " dated 
19.02.2022 and “ Daily Udaan ( Urdu ) ” dated 08.03.2022 under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 4th January, 2023 
S.O. 24(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, 5.00. 255(E) dated 3.05.2022, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter 


referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 


0 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] 


of NHI49B on the stretch of land from Km. !2.000 to Km 38.200 (Champa-Korba-Chhuri-Katghora section) 
Package-I in the District of Korba in the state of Chhattisgarh. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in "Haribhoomi” and “The Hitvada” both 
dated 09.06.2022; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section () of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 4652 (अ) , नई दिल्‍ली, दिनांक 03.0.2022 जो भारत 
के राजपत्र, असाधारण, भाग ||, खण्ड 3, उपखंड () में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा मध्य प्रदेश राज्य के बालाघाट जिले में 
NH-543 के कि.मी. 0 से कि.मी.5.9 (तहसील - लालबर्रा , जिला - बालाघाट ) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण 


(चोड़ाकरने / चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में 
विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "48.40.2022 " 
को "दैनिक भास्कर " और "द हितवादा " दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया

अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (॥) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 4th January, 2023 


S.O. 2(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, S.O. 4652 (E) New Delhi Dated 03.0.2022, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, 
Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of NH-543 on the stretch of land from Km 0 to Km 5.9 (Tehsil - Lalbarra, District- Balaghat) in the district 
of BALAGHAT in the state of MADHYA PRADESH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Dainik Bhaskar, Jabalpur” and 
“The Hitvada, Jabalpur” both dated /8./0.2022 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in the exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 4th January, 2023 


S.O. 44(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, number S. (0. 340(E) dated 25th January, 2022, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, 
Section 3, Sub-section (11) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of NH-58 (renamed as NH-334) on the stretch of land from Km 152.000 to Km 210.620 in the district of 
HARIDWAR in the state of UTTARAKHAND. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Amar Ujala” and “Times of 
India” both dated 26th February, 2022 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब , केन्द्रीय सरकार , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 घ की उपधारा ( 2 ) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर , उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 4th January , 2023 

S.O. 42 ( E ) . Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways , S.O. 5217 ( E ) Dated : - 09.11.2022 , published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 3 , Sub 
section ( ii ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declare its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building ( four / six laning , etc . , ) maintenance , management of Newly proposed 
Bangalore - Mydakuru ( Kadapa ) - Amarvathi / Vijayawada Greenfield access controlled Economic Corridor from 
Km . 75.000 to Km . 199.000 in the district of Y. S. R. Kadapa in the state of ANDHRA PRADESH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " The Hans India " and " Praja 
Shakti " both dated 12.11.2022 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , केन्द्रीय सरकार , एतद्वारा यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट 
भूमि का पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अधिग्रहण किया जाना चाहिए ;

New Delhi , the 4th January , 2023 

S.O. 41 ( E ) . Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways number S.O. 4320 ( E ) , dated the 14th September , 2022 , Published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary ,

1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) ( hereinafter referred to as the said Act , ) the Central government declared its intention to acquire the 
land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for " construction of Ramnagar & Balisai By - pass on 
NH - 116B from Km 72.119 to Km 78.600 ( Length 6.481 km ) of NH - 116B in connection with rehabilitation and

( 0.000 Km . To 90.775 Km ) of NH - 116B in the District of Purba Medinipur in the State of West Bengal ; " 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " The Times of 
India " and " Bartaman Patrika ” both dated on 27.09.2022 under sub - section ( 3 ) of Section 3A of the said Act ;

परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 5328(अ.), तारीख 76.47.2022 जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग |, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (ii) A प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा मध्य प्रदेश राज्य के जबलपुर जिले में रिंग रोड के 
कि.मी. 39.200 से कि.मी.75.400 (अनुविभागीय अधिकारी (राजस्व) कार्यालय पाटन) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के 
निर्माण (चौड़ा करने/चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध 
अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "27.4.2022 " 
को "पत्रिका जबलपुर" और "द हितवाद जबलपुर" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 


है; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा () के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है;

अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 


की उपधारा (॥) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 


इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

Hitavada Jabalpur” both dated 27.]].2022, under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section () of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 5th January , 2023 

S.O. 39 ( E ) .— Whereas , the Unlawful Activities ( Prevention ) Act , 1967 ( 37 of 1967 ) ( hereinafter referred to 
as the said Act ) has been enacted to provide for more effective prevention of certain unlawful activities of individuals 
and associations and for dealing with terrorist activities and for matters connected therewith ; 


And whereas , clause ( a ) of sub - section ( 1 ) and sub - section ( 2 ) of section 35 of the said Act empowers the 
Central Government to add the name of an individual in the Fourth Schedule to the said Act , if it believes that he is 
involved in terrorism ; 


And whereas , Mohammed Amin Khubaiab @Abu Khubaiab @Pinna @Muhammed Amin Butt son of 
Dawood Bhat beloging to Village Kathawa , Tehsil Phagsoo , District Doda , Jammu presently based in Pakistan is 
acting as launching commander of Lashkar - E - Taiba ( LeT ) ; 

And whereas , Lashkar - E - Taiba is listed as a terrorist organisation at serial No. 5 of the First Schedule to the 
said Act ; 


And whereas , the said Mohammed Amin Khubaiab @Abu Khubaiab @Pinna @Muhammed Amin Butt has 
developed a deep association with the cross border agencies and is playing a vital role to revive and accelerate terrorist 
activities of LeT in the Jammu Region of the Union Territory of Jasmmu and Kashmir ; 


And whereas , the said Mohammed Amin Khubaiab @Abu Khubaiab @Pinna @Muhammed Amin Butt has 
been involved in coordinating terrorists attacks , supply of arms or weapons and explosives , terror financing in Jammu 
and Kashmir from across the border ; 


[ भाग II 


-खण्ड 3 ( ii ) ] 


भारत का राजपत्र : असाधारण 


And whereas , the Central Government believes that Mohammed Amin Khubaiab @ Abu Khubaiab @Pinna 
@Muhammed Amin Butt is involved in terrorism and the said Mohammed Amin Khubaiab @ Abu Khubaiab @Pinna 
@Muhammed Amin Butt is to be added as a terrorist under the said Act ; 

Now , therefore , in exercise of the powers conferred by clause ( a ) of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 35 of the 
Unlawful Activities ( Prevention ) Act , 1967 , the Central Government hereby makes the following amendment in the 
Fourth Schedule to the said Act , namely :

In the Fourth Schedule to the said Act , after serial number 49 and entries relating thereto , the following serial 
number and entries shall be inserted , namely : 

" 50. Mohammed Amin Khubaiab @Abu Khubaiab @Pinna @Muhammed Amin Butt ” .

New Delhi, the 29th December,2022 


G.S.R.. 10(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) and clause (a) of sub-section (2) of 
section 18 of the Central Reserve Police Force Act, 1949 (66 of 1949), the Central Government hereby makes the 
following rules regulating the method of recruitment for the post of Assistant Sub-Inspector (Pharmacist) Veterinary 
post in the Central Reserve Police Force, namely: - 


1. Short title and commencement. — (1) These rules may be called the Central Reserve Police Force, Assistant 
Sub-Inspector (Pharmacist) Veterinary, Group ‘C’ (Combatised) Post, Recruitment Rules, 2022. 


(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


2. | Number of posts, classification and level in the pay matrix. —The number of post, its classification, level in 
pay matrix attached thereto shall be as specified in Columns (2) to (4) of the Schedule annexed to these rules. 


3. Method of recruitment, age-limit and other qualifications ete—The method of recruitment, age-limit, 
qualifications and other matters relating to the said post shall be as specified in Columns (5) to (13) of the said 
Schedule. 


4. Disqualification. — No person, - 
(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 
(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, 
shall be eligible for appointment to the said post: 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal law 
applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt any 
person from the operation of this rule. 


5. Medical Fitness. —The medical category SHAPE-1 shall be required for promotion. 


6. Power to relax.— Where the Central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, it 
may, by order, for reasons to be recorded in writing, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect of any class 
or category of person. 


7. Saving.—Nothing in these rules shall affect reservation, relaxation of age-limit and other concessions required 
to be provided for the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, the Other Backward Classes, the Ex-servicemen and 
other special categories of person in accordance with the orders issued by the Central Government.

99.0. 43(E).—S.O. 973 E dated 03/03/2022—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the

Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (1) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to 
acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), 
maintenance, management and operation of NH754A on the stretch of land from Km 141 to Km 155 (DRO office, 
Bathinda), NH754A on the stretch of land from Km 89 to Km 137 (DRO office, Bathinda), NH754A on the stretch of 
land from Km 137 to Km 141 (DRO office, Bathinda) in the district of BATHINDA in the state of PUNJAB 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Times of India (English) and “Ajit 
(Punjabi)” both dated 11/03/2022; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

दिनांक 06.03.2019 के बी ( I ) , बी ( III ) और बी ( IV ) के अधीन कोयले के आबंटन सहित मॉडल बोली दस्तावेजों के अधीन 
यथाप्रदत्त डिजाइन , निर्माण , वित्त , स्वामित्व और प्रचालन ( डीबीएफओओ ) आधार और स्रोत ईंधन पर स्थापित थर्मल पावर 
स्टेशनों से विद्युत की दीर्घकालिक उपाप्ति के लिए मार्गनिर्देश के संशोधन पर दिनांक 11.07.2022 के प्रस्ताव के अनुसरण में ,

MINISTRY OF HOME AFFAIRS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 5th January, 2023 


S.O. 45(E).—whereas, the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967 (37 of 1967) (hereinafter referred to 
as the said Act) has been enacted to provide for more effective prevention of certain unlawful activities of individuals 
and associations and for dealing with terrorist activities and for matters connected therewith; 


And whereas, as per clause (m) of sub-section (1) of section 2 of the said Act, ‘terrorist organisation’ means 
an organisation listed in the First Schedule to the said Act or an organisation operating under the same name as an 
organisation so listed; 


And whereas, the First Schedule to the said Act contains the list of such terrorist organisations; 


And whereas, ‘The Resistance Front’ came into existence in the year 2019 as a proxy outfit of Lashkar-E- 
Taiba, a proscribe terrorist organisation listed at serial number 5 of the First Schedule under the said Act; 


[भाग 1--खण्ड 3(i1)] भारत का राजपत्र : असाधारण 3 


And whereas, the ‘The Resistance Front’ is recruiting youth through online medium for furtherance of 
terrorist activities; 


And whereas, the ‘The Resistance Front’ has been involved in carrying out propaganda on terror activities, 
recruitment of terrorists, infiltration of terrorists and smuggling of weapons and narcotics from Pakistan into Jammu 
and Kashmir; 


And whereas, the ‘The Resistance Front’ is involved in psychological operations on social media platforms 
for inciting people of Jammu and Kashmir to join terrorist outfits against Indian State; 


And whereas, Sheikh Sajjad Gul is a Commander of ‘The Resistance Front’ and has been designated as a 
terrorist under the fourth schedule of the said Act; 


And whereas, the activities of “The Resistance Front’ are detrimental for the national security and 
sovereignty of India; 


And whereas, a large number of cases have been registered against the members/associates of “The 
Resistance Front’ relating to planning of killings of Security Force personnel and innocent civilians of Jammu and 
Kashmir, co-coordinating and transporting weapons to support proscribed terrorist organisation, terror attack on 
security forces, killing of innocent persons, etc.; 


And whereas, the Central Government believes that the ‘The Resistance Front’ is involved in terrorism and it 
has committed and participated in various acts of terrorism in India; 


Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by clause (a) of sub-section (1) of section 35 of the 
Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967, the Central Government hereby makes the following further 
amendments in the First Schedule to the said Act, namely:- 


In the First Schedule to the said Act, in serial number 5, after the words “Pasban-E-Ahle Hadis”, the words 
“/The Resistance Front and all its manifestations and front Organisations” shall be inserted. 


[F.No. 11034/13/2022/CT-I] 
PRAVEEN VASHISTA, Addl. Secy.
